name: Lesson 7 · Floaters and sections
intro: Sections close out ahead of you. Float over the whitewater or get around it.

goals.hint: Unweight both feet (both sticks up) as you reach the whitewater to float over the section
goals.hintClassic: When a section warning shows, press L (Y) as you reach the whitewater to float over it

goals.hint: Two sections survived: float over, or drive past on the nose before they close
goals.hintClassic: Two sections survived: floater over, or pump past before they close
